name: Red Lentil Soup with Cabbage, Carrots, Celery & Avocado-Garlic Toast
ingredients: 48 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Meanwhile, place lentils in the colander, rinse, and set aside to drain.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, about 5 minutes.
While the veggies cook, trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.

Add cabbage, lentils, and broth to the pot; stir to combine, cover, and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low and continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils and vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Slice buns in half and place, cut-side up, on a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with garlic and spices.
Place buns in the oven and toast until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Halve and pit the avocado; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Arrange avocado slices on top of the garlic toast.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with avocado-garlic toast on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
